## Selected Media Coverage

**[Public Finance in the Age of AI: A Primer](https://leemlockwood.com/papers/korinek-lockwood-2025-public-finance-ai.pdf)** (with Anton Korinek) — Featured by [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/research/economic-policy-responses), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/feb/23/ai-how-will-we-be-fed), and [Marginal Revolution](https://marginalrevolution.com/marginalrevolution/2026/02/public-finance-in-the-age-of-ai-a-primer.html)

**[Beyond Health: Non-Health Risk and the Value of Disability Insurance](https://leemlockwood.com/papers/deshpande-lockwood-2022-disability-insurance.pdf)** (with Manasi Deshpande) — Featured by [Microeconomic Insights](https://microeconomicinsights.org/beyond-health-nonhealth-risk-and-the-value-of-disability-insurance/), [Becker Friedman Institute for Economics](https://bfi.uchicago.edu/insight/research-summary/beyond-health-non-health-risk-and-the-value-of-disability-insurance/?occurrence_id=0), and [Washington Center for Equitable Growth](https://equitablegrowth.org/working-papers/beyond-health-non-health-risk-and-the-value-of-disability-insurance/)

**[Government Old-Age Support and Labor Supply](https://leemlockwood.com/papers/fetter-lockwood-2018-old-age-assistance.pdf)** (with Daniel Fetter) — Featured in the [NBER Digest](https://www.nber.org/digest/jun16/labor-supply-and-old-age-assistance-program), as the AEA [Chart of the Week](https://www.aeaweb.org/research/charts/old-age-assistance-programs-labor-supply-impact), and by the [Institute for Policy Research](https://www.ipr.northwestern.edu/news/2016/lockwood-old-age-assistance-retirement.html), [Cato Research Briefs in Economic Policy](https://www.cato.org/research-briefs-economic-policy/government-old-age-support-labor-supply-evidence-old-age-assistance), and [Cato Policy Report](https://www.cato.org/policy-report/july/august-2016/menu-police)

**[Targeting with In-Kind Transfers: Evidence from Medicaid Home Care](https://leemlockwood.com/papers/lieber-lockwood-2019-medicaid-home-care.pdf)** (with Ethan Lieber) — Featured in [Public Finance and Public Policy](https://store.macmillanlearning.com/us/product/Public-Finance-and-Public-Policy/p/1319281109) (Jonathan Gruber) and by the [American Economic Association](https://www.aeaweb.org/research/in-kind-vs-cash-medicaid-home-care)
